verdict.rationale: YYLO documents Git-level isolation: dedicated task branches/worktrees with configured dependency hydration, and benchmark candidates run in 'private fresh repositories'. That is version-control workspace separation, not an execution sandbox that confines agent-run code or dependency installs from the host. Read-only preflight is a dry-run style check, not sandbox isolation, so these are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox
